campaign: gated EKF baro vertical-velocity aid: outage duration x wind matrix
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
gate: g_baro_vel_aid_enable && g_mode_degraded_gnss && age>8 s && baro altitude at activation >=10 m (latched)
scenario: 30 m settled, outage 43 s to 43+dur, 1 m/s2 wind on/off, 6 dirs x 10 seeds, aid off/on; dur 10/20/30/60 s
verdict: 10 s is neutral (aid active only 2 s); 20-60 s strongly reduces touchdown tails, especially with wind (30 s wind 3.35->0.88 median, 60 s wind 3.35->1.10). Drift p95/max worsens with longer duration/wind (30 s wind 579->1196 m p95; 60 s wind 554->1127 m p95). This is a safety-vs-footprint trade, not a free improvement. Default off; enable only for >=10 m activation and long no-flow outages when touchdown safety is prioritized.
caveats: The 10 s outage recovers before the descent completes; aid is active for only ~2 s and is neutral.
Drift is physical (no horizontal absolute reference); the aid slows the descent, extending wind exposure.
All numbers are scalar-Eigen SIL L2, not real aircraft.
